question: Identify the **INCORRECT** pair with respect to the substances and their specific heat capacity (J kg⁻¹K⁻¹) at room temperature and atmospheric pressure.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Water-1200.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Specific Heat Capacity**

__
 
• The **quantity of heat (J) absorbed per unit mass (kg)** of the material or substance when its** temperature increases 1 K (or 1 °C).**
 
• Its units are **J/(kg K) or J/(kg °C).**

**Atmospheric Pressure**

 
• The** average air pressure at sea level at a temperature of 15 degrees Celsius**.
 
• ​An** atmosphere (atm)** is a unit.
 
• 1**atm** = 1,013 millibars or 760 millimeters of mercury.
 
• **Atmospheric pressure drops as altitude increases.**
